name: Swatchify – Variation Swatches for WooCommerce
author: Digital Web Tutor

sections.description:
Swatchify is a minimal, lightweight, and fast plugin that converts standard WooCommerce variation dropdowns into beautiful and user-friendly text swatches. This enhances the user experience of your WooCommerce store, allowing customers to easily select product variations.

Features:
* Converts variation dropdowns to clickable text swatches.
* Works seamlessly with standard WooCommerce products.
* Minimalist and lightweight coding for optimal performance.
* Choose between Square, Rounded, or Circle swatches via a simple settings panel.

How to Use

Using Swatchify is completely automatic. It applies to your existing WooCommerce variable products out of the box:

  1. Create a Variable Product in WooCommerce (Products -> Add New -> Product Data: Variable product).
  2. Under the “Attributes” tab, add your attributes (e.g., Size, Color) and make sure “Used for variations” is checked.
  3. Under the “Variations” tab, generate your variations and assign prices to them.
  4. Publish the product and view it on the front end. The native WooCommerce dropdowns will automatically be converted to beautifully styled, clickable swatches!
  5. To change the shape of the swatches, navigate to Settings -> Swatchify Settings in your WordPress dashboard and choose between Square, Rounded, or Circle shapes.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/swatchify-variation-swatches directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
sections.faq:
Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes, WooCommerce is required for this plugin to work.
